project.name: hermes-agent-for-hau
project.description: Workspace AI thực chiến trên nền Hermes để hỗ trợ công việc với AIMS, SOP, vendor, project coordination, analytics/reporting và governance.

features: Templates: SOP, fit-gap, vendor-question, executive-memo, weekly-status, project-plan
Domain context: AIMS overview, department roles, vendor rules, integration rules, analytics rules
Sanitized real examples for AI learning

outputs_produced.title: SOP — AIMS User Access Creation & Management
Fit-Gap Assessment — AIMS Crew Management Module
Vendor Question Pack — Crew Module Gaps (18 questions)
Executive Memo — AIMS Crew Module Upgrade
Weekly Status Report — AIMS Crew Module
Project Plan — AIMS Crew Module Upgrade (14 weeks, 6 phases)

decisions.decision: Dùng repo Hermes làm nền, thêm layer riêng cho Hau
decisions.reason: Tận dụng agent framework có sẵn

decisions.decision: Memory-bank first-pass đã copy vào 5 file chính
decisions.reason: Kích hoạt workspace từ template sang live

decisions.decision: Tạo bộ output hoàn chỉnh cho AIMS Crew Module upgrade use case
decisions.reason: Chứng minh workspace hoạt động end-to-end: analysis → action → decision → execution → tracking → governance

patterns: SOP follows governance template with appendices (form, approval matrix, tracker, role mapping)
Fit-Gap uses 12-column table: ID, Process, Current, Desired, Gap, Root Cause, Impact, Feasibility, Action, Owner, Priority, Status
Vendor questions grouped by topic with priority matrix and short email version
Executive memo follows: Summary → Recommendation → Rationale → Risks → Decision Needed → Next Steps
All outputs cross-reference each other via document codes (SOP-AIMS-UAM-001, FGA-AIMS-CRW-001, etc.)
conventions: Document codes: SOP-AIMS-XXX-NNN, FGA-AIMS-XXX-NNN, VQP-AIMS-XXX-NNN, PP-AIMS-XXX-NNN
Memory-bank updated after each output creation
All outputs are Word-ready (formal, structured, production-quality)
